There's way too much stuff in here that isn't even relevant to us (ex. OSX, Fuscia, Webkit).  We need to get a reference copy in docs first before I merge this one.
Thanks for the update Can you add these points in Reference commit https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/docs/+/76345 , That way we can document all comments at one point.
It doesn't look like you used `config-clang-tidy merge` here but instead you edited it by hand?
Acknowledged

We might need to do something to disable clang-tidy on anything from stdexec.  You might be able to disable clang-tidy to includes entirely in `async/execution.hpp` and `async/task.hpp`.  Or maybe there is some magic we can do to HeaderFilterRegex.
Thanks , will look.
Added .clang-tidy-ignore files which will help to disbale selected files.please see https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/sdbusplus/+/86199/1 for details.
